# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 38 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_038_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 38

**1** Jesus said: "Many times you have longed to hear these words that I am speaking to you, and you have no one else from whom to hear them.

**2** There will be days when you will seek me and will not find me."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Longed to hear" — the desire has been persistent and deep
- "No one else" — Jesus's teaching is uniquely available; there is no alternative source
- "Will seek me and will not find me" — the urgency; the access to this source is not permanent
